comments.author: Friend135
comments.body: What kind of animations and assets are you looking for?  There are many different AI’s with different strengths in terms of asset creation.  But, I will say that many of those AI’s are inconsistent with asset creation.  But, they are getting better.   ChatGPT is pretty good at concept art, but not so good with animations and it can’t do 3D to my knowledge.  PixelLab is great for pixel art and can do basic animations.

comments.author: IDMyourmom
comments.body: Just tell this to Claude and it will help you. Have Claude make conceptual art with code, iterate on it (tell it what changes you want), and then it can generate it with Blender (or ask what tools it recommends). Just be honest with what you don't know and don't try to strictly guide processes you don't understand. It is a great resource for questions you have.

comments.author: VortexAssetStudio
comments.body: since you already have the combat system working, don't try to force one single tool to do everything. for 2d static assets, items, and environment concepts, image models like flux work great as long as you keep your style prompts consistent and generate on clean neutral backgrounds so they are easy to cut out. for actual character animations, you're usually better off using pre-made animation libraries (like mixamo) or dedicated 3d generators rather than trying to make an llm or image generator animate frame by frame.

comments.author: Famous_Ad_5611
comments.body:
Ok so there are some good ideas here in other comments. So what can you do is look at orchestrators - tools like t3.code that can attach multiple models beneath it and you choose what Ai model to use and so on. (You can attach both antigravity account and Claude) and ask it for pixel art. Claude does better pixelart but Gemini can do some nice things too 

That is one route. The other? Actually use Google hydrogen to operate blender. I tested it out of curiosity and Ai explained how to install and configure blender so Ai can connect to it and use it to build models. A little but of manual work, some clicking and vuala it should work. Again Claude is better but other models can do it also.

There are other interesting things like for example a free elevnlabs account with 10k credits and ability to create interesting workshops and pipelines and even connect to your Ai via Api so it can create voice overs.

Or you could just do normal nano banan images and ask Ai to create a script to anime it... not best solution but I saw some amazing tech demos with this approach.
